verdict.rationale: Antigravity's agent can autonomously run terminal commands, tests, and searches via subagents (docs-7, docs-18) and produces diffs/artifacts and browser recordings that could aid debugging (docs-30), and its artifact review/approval flow supports iterative verification (docs-24, docs-25). However there is no explicit documentation of debugging-specific workflows like log/error triage, root-cause analysis tooling, or test-driven fix verification loops, and community reports describe bugs, unreliable terminal auto-execution, and a subpar harness that undercut trust in autonomous reproduction/fix cycles (comm-6, comm-8, comm-14). missing for 10: dedicated debugging/root-cause-analysis workflow docs, explicit test-run-and-verify loop documentation, independent hands-on evidence of successful bug reproduction and fix verification.
